notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. APS 5019 (system policy, effective 2016-11-17, 'Applies to: All Campuses') governs; the CU Denver | Anschutz campus policy (effective 2018-01-01) only lets schools, colleges or departments offer additional parental leave, run concurrently with FMLA and APS 5019 and funded by the unit; it sets no benefit itself, so it is not a component. No unit-level policy adopted under it is saved (none named).
2018_04 (Regent Law Article 5) holds the seven-year tenure probationary period (5.B.4(D)) to which APS 5019's tenure-clock stop refers; it holds no leave provision of its own.

2018_03 (Faculty Handbook, Compensation and Leave) is a system summary page captured 2017-07-01; it points to APS 5019 for parental leave and to the FML policy; its sick-leave, general-leave and leave-sharing paragraphs are coded (c12-c15). Military leave, leave for political candidates and sabbatical assignments are not parental provisions (not components).

Birth parent chain: APS 5019 parental leave 18 weeks (own sick leave, then half pay), with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent from its start -> discretionary leave without pay (or reduced loads, in lieu) consecutive_after it, to a 32-week total (leave limit 32). Sick leave (own accrual) lies within the parental leave.

Non-birth parent chain: identical to the birth parent: APS 5019 parental leave 18 weeks with FMLA 12 concurrent -> discretionary leave without pay to a 32-week total. The negotiated alternative arrangement (c5) is in lieu of the 18-week leave.

Cross-references not saved: short-term disability plan (FML guideline D.3.c); 'disability coverage' (Handbook V.B.1); Regent Action 11/21/47 on sick leave; APS Leave Sharing for Officers, Exempt Professionals, and Faculty on Twelve-Month Appointments; Regent Policy 11-E Leave Policies; Regent Policy 5-F political candidates; Regent Policy 5-A sabbaticals; CU Boulder Parental Leave Policy (another campus; APS IV).
Unit-level additional parental leave that a school, college or department might offer under the campus policy cannot be determined from the saved documents.
